**Test image observations:**
- Leaf with angular, dark brown-to-black necrotic lesions
- Lesions are clearly vein-limited (angular shape, bounded by leaf veins)
- Yellowish-green halos visible around several lesions
- Some water-soaked appearance at lesion margins
- Lesions on leaf tissue, not stems or pods

**Comparison with references:**
- **Bacterial_Blight** reference: small angular spots with yellow halos on leaves — matches the test image pattern well (angular, vein-limited, halos present)
- **Diaporthe** reference: shows stem and pod symptoms — black pycnidia in linear rows on stems and pod blight — completely different from the leaf lesions in the test image

The angular, vein-limited lesions with yellowish-green halos on leaf tissue are the hallmark of Bacterial Blight. No stem/pod fruiting bodies visible. Diaporthe is ruled out entirely.
